_meta.doc: Template tenant — copy this directory to create a new tenant. Edit each intent's binding fields and response templates. See docs/responses-format.md for the full schema.

_docs_binding_fields.doc: Per-intent tracking binding fields (all optional). These feed the Layer-3 gestion tracking pipeline.
_docs_binding_fields.capability: string — one of the Capability enum values in gestion_catalog.py. Declares what capability this intent exercises. Omit if the intent has no trackable capability (e.g. saludo, despedida).
_docs_binding_fields.terminal_signal: string — one of: info_provided | proof | commitment | escalation | fallback | identity_failed. Marks this intent as a terminal turn and drives the outcome. Omit if the intent is non-terminal.
_docs_binding_fields.escalation_reason: string — one of the OutcomeReason enum values. Only meaningful when terminal_signal=escalation. Omit otherwise.

example_info_intent.description: Example: intent that delivers information and closes the conversation.

example_escalation_intent.description: Example: intent that escalates to a human agent.
example_escalation_intent.template: Connecting you with an agent now.

example_unannotated_intent.description: Example: intent with no binding (saludo-style). No capability or signal — produces outcome=unresolved.
